question: Who was the president of the first meeting of the constituent assembly which was held on December 9, 1946?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha** was the president of the first meeting of the Constituent Assembly held on December 9, 1946.
 
• He was appointed as the temporary president of the assembly, a role that was later taken over by Dr. Rajendra Prasad.
 
• The Constituent Assembly was formed to draft the Constitution of India and included members from different regions and communities.
 
• The assembly had its first meeting in the Central Hall of Parliament House, New Delhi.
 
• The formation of the Constituent Assembly was a significant step towards India's independence and democratic governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constituent Assembly** was composed of members who were elected by the provincial assemblies by a single, transferable-vote system of proportional representation.
 
• The assembly held its sessions over a period of nearly three years, with the final session ending on January 24, 1950.
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the permanent chairman of the Constituent Assembly on December 11, 1946.
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted on November 26, 1949, and came into effect on January 26, 1950, a date now celebrated as Republic Day in India.
 
• The assembly included prominent leaders such as Jawaharlal Nehru, Sardar Patel, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, and others who played crucial roles in framing the Constitution.
 
• The drafting committee, chaired by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, was responsible for drafting the text of the Constitution.
